definition_zh: 模棱两可的；有歧义的；不明确的
definition_en: having more than one possible meaning, or not clear enough to be understood in only one way
core_image: 一块同时指向两条路的路牌
scene: The contract clause was so ambiguous that both sides read it as supporting their own claim.
sceneCN: 这里 ambiguous 是「有歧义的、可作两种解释的」（第 1 个义项：存在不止一种解释）；句意：合同条款歧义太大，双方都把它读成支持自己的主张。场景要点：一份合同、两种读法、双方各执一词。

forms.label: 比较级（更多用 more 构成）
最高级（更多用 most 构成）

derivatives.zh: 明确无误的；不含歧义的

senses.title: Two readings at once
senses.titleCN: 一形两读：可作两种解释
senses.definition: having two or more possible meanings that a reader or listener cannot choose between
senses.definitionCN: 有两个或更多可能的含义，读者或听者无法确定该选哪一个
senses.example: 'Bank' is ambiguous here: it can mean a river bank or a financial institution.
senses.exampleCN: 这里的 bank 有歧义：它既可以指河岸，也可以指金融机构。
senses.why: Latin ambiguus came from ambigere, 'to wander about, to dispute'. A meaning that wanders in two directions at once is exactly what English calls ambiguous.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ambiguus 来自 ambigere，意为“四处游走、争执”。一个意思同时在两个方向上游走，正是英语所说的 ambiguous。

senses.title: Not clear enough to act on
senses.titleCN: 表述不清：不足以据此行动
senses.definition: not expressed clearly enough to show what should be done
senses.definitionCN: 表达得不够清楚，无法据此判断该做什么
senses.example: The brief was ambiguous about who would approve the final design.
senses.exampleCN: 任务说明对由谁批准最终设计含糊不清。
senses.why: The same fork appears in practical instructions: when the wording does not settle on one route, the reader cannot decide what to do.
senses.whyCN: 同一个分叉也出现在实际指示里：措辞没有落在某一条路上，读的人就无法决定该怎么做。

senses.title: Pulled two ways: an uncertain attitude
senses.titleCN: 态度摇摆：两种心思之间
senses.definition: showing uncertainty because two feelings or intentions are present at the same time
senses.definitionCN: 同时存在两种情绪或意图，因而显得不确定
senses.example: Her ambiguous smile made it impossible to tell whether she agreed.
senses.exampleCN: 她那模棱两可的笑让人无法判断她是否同意。
senses.why: The Latin verb also described a mind that goes around a question without landing. An ambiguous attitude is that movement made visible on the face.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词也形容心思绕着问题打转、迟迟不落地。所谓模棱两可的态度，就是把这种打转写在了脸上。

senses.title: Hard to classify: between two categories
senses.definition: not clearly belonging to one category, role, or status
senses.definitionCN: 不能清楚地归入某一类别、角色或身份
senses.example: The volunteer held an ambiguous position between staff member and guest.
senses.exampleCN: 那名志愿者的身份很模糊，介于正式员工和客人之间。
senses.why: To classify something is to place it in one category. An ambiguous thing refuses that placement, so it keeps wandering between the boxes.
senses.whyCN: 归类就是把某物放进一个格子里。模糊的事物拒绝被放进去，于是它在几个格子之间来回游走。

senses.title: Deliberately evasive wording
senses.titleCN: 故意含糊：给自己留后路
senses.definition: worded so that the speaker can later claim either meaning
senses.definitionCN: 措辞被有意设计成日后可以任选一种解释
senses.example: The minister gave an ambiguous answer that avoided the word 'resign'.
senses.exampleCN: 那位部长给了一个含糊的回答，避开了“辞职”这个词。
senses.why: When ambiguity is chosen rather than accidental, the fork becomes a shelter: both exits stay open, and no single reading can be pinned on the speaker.
senses.whyCN: 当歧义是故意选用的而不是偶然出现的，分叉就成了庇护所：两条出口都开着，别人无法把某一种解释钉在说话人身上。

senses.title: Structural ambiguity in language
senses.titleCN: 结构歧义：语法可有两种切分
senses.definition: in grammar and logic, able to be parsed in more than one way
senses.definitionCN: 在语法和逻辑中，可以按不止一种方式切分理解
senses.example: The headline was structurally ambiguous: 'visiting relatives can be tiring' has two parses.
senses.exampleCN: 这个标题在结构上有歧义：visiting relatives 可以理解为“来访的亲戚”，也可以理解为“拜访亲戚”。
senses.why: Grammar has its own roads. A sentence whose words can be grouped in two ways is ambiguous in the technical sense, because the structure itself forks.
senses.whyCN: 语法有自己的路网。一个句子的词能按两种方式成组，就是技术意义上的歧义，因为结构本身出现了分叉。

senses.title: Perceptual ambiguity: two images in one
senses.titleCN: 知觉双关：一张图两种读法
senses.definition: in perception, able to be seen as either of two figures
senses.definitionCN: 在知觉上，同一幅图可以被看成两个不同形象
senses.example: The duck-rabbit drawing is an ambiguous figure: you see one animal or the other.
senses.exampleCN: 鸭兔图是一幅歧义图形：你要么看到鸭子，要么看到兔子。
senses.why: The eye, like the reader, can take the same lines in two directions. The figure stays the same while the interpretation flips.
senses.whyCN: 眼睛和读者一样，能把同样的线条往两个方向读。图形没有变，变的是解释。

senses.title: Ambiguous loss: grief without a clear ending
senses.titleCN: 模糊性丧失：没有结局的悲伤
senses.definition: in psychology, a loss that is unclear or unresolved, such as a person who has disappeared
senses.definitionCN: 心理学中指不清晰、未解决的丧失，例如某人失踪、下落不明
senses.example: Families of the missing often live with ambiguous loss for years.
senses.exampleCN: 失踪者的家庭常常多年处在“模糊性丧失”之中。
senses.why: Here the uncertainty is not in the wording but in the event: neither presence nor absence can be confirmed, so mourning never finds a fixed object.
senses.whyCN: 这里的模糊不在措辞，而在事件本身：既不能确认他在，也不能确认他不在，哀悼因此找不到一个固定的对象。

intro.en: Ambiguous came straight from Latin in the 16th century, without passing through French. Its history is the history of a meaning that walks in two directions.
intro.cn: ambiguous 在 16 世纪直接从拉丁语进入英语，没有经过法语。它的历史，就是一个“朝两个方向走”的词义的历史。

items.en: First recorded in the 1520s in the sense 'of doubtful meaning'. The related noun ambiguity is older, dating from around 1400.
items.cn: 最早记录于 1520 年代，意为“含义可疑、不确定”。相关名词 ambiguity 更早，约在 1400 年已出现。

items.en: Latin ambiguus meant 'having double meaning, uncertain, wavering'. English borrowed it directly, keeping both the 'two meanings' and the 'uncertain' branches.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ambiguus 意为“有双重含义的、不确定的、摇摆的”。英语直接借入，同时保留了“两义”和“不确定”两条分支。

items.en: The adjective came from ambigere 'to wander about, dispute, be undecided': ambi- 'around, both ways' + agere 'to drive, do'. The picture is a mind or argument driven around the same question.
items.cn: 这个形容词来自动词 ambigere“四处游走、争执、犹豫不决”：ambi-“周围、两边”+ agere“驱动、做”。画面是一个心思或争论被赶着绕同一个问题打转。

items.en: The parts go back to PIE *ambhi- 'around' and *ag- 'to drive'. These are reconstructed roots, and the deeper semantic link is generally accepted rather than directly attested.
items.cn: 两部分可追溯到原始印欧语 *ambhi-“周围”和 *ag-“驱动”。这些是重构词根，更深一层的语义联系是学界一般接受的推断，而非直接文献证据。

items.en: Ambiguity and unambiguous share the same Latin base. Ambition and ambient share only the ambhi- part; their second element is ire 'to go', not agere, so they are prefix relatives rather than true synonyms of the root.
items.cn: ambiguity、unambiguous 共享同一拉丁词根。ambition、ambient 只共享 ambhi- 这一部分，它们的第二成分是 ire“走”而不是 agere，因此只是前缀层面的亲属，不是同一词根。

items.en: Modern English keeps the core image of a fork. The word has expanded from doubtful wording to uncertain attitudes, unclear roles, grammatical parses, visual figures and unresolved loss.
items.cn: 现代英语保留了“分叉”的核心意象。这个词从“含义可疑的措辞”扩展到摇摆的态度、模糊的身份、语法切分、视觉图形和没有结局的丧失。

note.en: The first group is built on shared spelling and the ambi- prefix; the second group collects words that are close in meaning but not in form.
note.cn: 第一组按共同拼写和 ambi- 前缀归拢，第二组收意思接近但词形不同的词。

entries.definition: having mixed or conflicting feelings about someone or something. It shares ambi- 'both' but its second element is valent 'strength', not agere.
entries.definitionCN: 对某人或某事同时怀有矛盾的情感。它共享 ambi-“两边”，但第二成分是 valent“力量”，不是 agere。

entries.definition: full of ambition; eager for success. It looks close at the start but belongs to the ambire 'go around to canvass' family.
entries.definitionCN: 有雄心的；渴望成功的。开头看起来相近，但它属于 ambire“四处奔走拉票”的词族。

entries.definition: the noun from ambiguous: the state of having more than one meaning. It is a different part of speech, not a different root.
entries.definitionCN: ambiguous 派生的名词：具有不止一种含义的状态。它只是不同词性，不是另一个词根。

entries.definition: not precise or detailed. Vague says there is too little information; ambiguous says the information can be read in more than one way.
entries.definitionCN: 不精确、不具体。vague 强调信息太少；ambiguous 强调现有信息能被读成不止一种意思。

entries.definition: able to be understood in two ways, often on purpose and with a hint of evasion. It is narrower and more literary than ambiguous.
entries.definitionCN: 可作两种理解，常带故意回避的意味。它比 ambiguous 更窄、更书面。

entries.definition: not easy to understand or see. It is a broader word: a text can be unclear because it is badly written without being ambiguous.
entries.definitionCN: 不容易理解或看清。它范围更广：一篇文章可以只是因为写得差而不清楚，并不一定存在歧义。

entries.definition: hard to understand because it is rare, hidden, or badly explained. It stresses inaccessible knowledge rather than a double reading.
entries.definitionCN: 因生僻、隐晦或解释不清而难懂。它强调知识难以接近，而不是存在两种读法。

normalIntro.en: Real word parts and real relatives: ambi- 'both ways', the ambigere family, and the everyday derivatives ambiguity and unambiguous.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实的构词成分与真实同族词：ambi-“两边”、ambigere 词族，以及日常派生词 ambiguity、unambiguous。

normal.en: ambi- means 'both, around', and agere means 'to drive'. Ambiguous is a meaning driven both ways at the same time.
normal.cn: ambi- 是“两边、周围”，agere 是“驱动”。ambiguous 就是同一个意思同时被往两个方向赶。

normal.en: The noun ambiguity is older than the adjective ambiguous: the state came first, the label came later.
normal.cn: 名词 ambiguity 比形容词 ambiguous 更早出现：先有“歧义”这个状态，后来才有形容它的词。

normal.en: Unambiguous uses un- to close one of the two roads; only one reading is left.
normal.cn: unambiguous 用 un- 关掉两条路中的一条，只剩下一种读法。

normal.en: To disambiguate is literally to remove the fork: a context or a rewrite tells you which road was meant.
normal.cn: disambiguate 字面就是“拆掉分叉”：靠语境或改写告诉你是哪条路。

normal.en: The duck-rabbit drawing is the classic ambiguous figure: the same lines support two animals, and your perception switches between them.
normal.cn: 鸭兔图是经典的歧义图形：同样的线条能支撑两个动物形象，你的知觉在两者之间切换。

abstract.en: Picture a signpost with two arrows pointing in different directions from one post. Ambiguous is the moment before you choose which arrow governs.
abstract.cn: 想象一根路标柱上伸出两支指向不同方向的箭头。ambiguous 就是你决定该听哪一支之前的那个瞬间。

abstract.en: The fork can be in the sentence, in the speaker's attitude, in a role, in a grammar tree, in a drawing, or in an unresolved loss.
abstract.cn: 这个分叉可以出现在句子里、说话人的态度里、一个角色里、语法树里、一幅画里，也可以出现在一段没有结局的丧失里。

abstract.en: The word does not mean 'confusing'. It means 'structured to support more than one path' — the confusion is the reader's response, not the word's content.
abstract.cn: 这个词不等于“让人困惑”。它的意思是“结构上支持不止一条路径”——困惑是读者的反应，不是词本身的内容。

examples.en: The wording of the rule is ambiguous, so the committee asked for a rewrite.
examples.cn: 这条规则的措辞有歧义，委员会要求重写。

examples.en: His ambiguous answer left everyone guessing about his real plan.
examples.cn: 他模棱两可的回答让所有人都猜不透他真正的计划。

examples.en: In logic, an ambiguous term must be replaced by a precise one before the argument can be tested.
examples.cn: 在逻辑中，必须先把这个有歧义的词换成精确的词，论证才能接受检验。

dict_mnemonic.text: “安比纠”——安比在两个说法之间纠来纠去，哪个都不肯定 → ambiguous 模棱两可的

root: 源自拉丁语 ambigere“四处游走、争执”，由 ambi-“两边”+ agere“驱动”构成，核心是“同一件事被拉向两个方向”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of ambiguous, all grown from one image: a single form that opens onto two roads, so the meaning or status never settles.
sensesIntro.cn: ambiguous 的八个义项都从同一个意象长出来：一个词形通向两条路，于是含义或身份始终不肯落定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one form, two roads; the meaning never settles on a single path.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个词形，两条路；含义始终不肯落在一条路上。

branches.en: WORDING: a term or sentence supports two readings, or is too loose to guide action.
branches.cn: 措辞：一个词或句子支持两种读法，或者松到不足以指导行动。

branches.en: UNCERTAIN STATES: feelings pulled two ways, and losses that can be neither confirmed nor closed.
branches.cn: 不确定状态：被两种情绪拉扯的心情，以及既无法确认也无法结束的丧失。

branches.en: CLASSIFICATION: a role or identity that falls between two boxes.
branches.cn: 归类：落在两个格子之间的角色或身份。

branches.en: EVASION: ambiguity chosen on purpose, so that both exits remain available to the speaker.
branches.cn: 回避：故意选择歧义，让说话人始终保留两条出口。

branches.en: FORMAL FORKS: grammatical parses and perceptual figures, where the same structure supports two interpretations.
branches.cn: 形式分叉：语法切分与知觉图形，同一结构支持两种解释。

intro.en: English does not build ambiguous from a live prefix. The ambi- part is frozen inside the Latin verb; English adds only ordinary suffixes to the borrowed adjective.
intro.cn: 英语并不是用活的前缀来造 ambiguous 的。ambi- 这部分凝固在拉丁动词里；英语只是在借来的形容词后面加普通后缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is built on ambigere 'to drive around, dispute': the verb, the adjective ambiguus, and the noun ambiguitas. English took the adjective and noun, then coined new derivatives.
latinIntro.cn: 这一拉丁词族建立在 ambigere“绕着走、争执”上：动词、形容词 ambiguus、名词 ambiguitas。英语借入形容词和名词，再自己造新派生词。

items.meaning: the state of having more than one meaning
items.meaningCN: 歧义；多义性（-ity 表示状态或性质）
items.example: The ambiguity of the sentence caused a long dispute.
items.exampleCN: 这句话的歧义引发了一场长时间的争论。

items.meaning: more than one ambiguous point
items.example: The editor removed several ambiguities from the draft.
items.exampleCN: 编辑删去了草稿中的几处歧义。

items.meaning: in a way that can be understood in more than one way
items.meaningCN: 模棱两可地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: He answered ambiguously and refused to explain.
items.exampleCN: 他含糊其辞地回答，并拒绝解释。

items.meaning: the quality of being ambiguous
items.meaningCN: 模糊性；歧义性（-ness 构成性质名词）
items.example: The ambiguousness of the map confused the hikers.
items.exampleCN: 地图含义不清，让徒步者迷了路。

items.meaning: having only one possible meaning
items.meaningCN: 明确无误的；只有一种解释的（un- 表示否定）
items.example: We need an unambiguous answer, yes or no.
items.exampleCN: 我们需要一个明确的答复，行或不行。

items.meaning: in a way that leaves no doubt
items.example: The court stated unambiguously that the contract was void.
items.exampleCN: 法院明确表示该合同无效。

items.meaning: the quality of leaving no room for a second reading
items.example: The test rewards unambiguousness of expression.
items.exampleCN: 这项测试奖励表达明确、不含歧义。

items.meaning: to remove ambiguity from something
items.meaningCN: 消除歧义；使含义明确（dis- 表示去除）
items.example: A pronoun can disambiguate the subject of the sentence.
items.exampleCN: 一个代词可以消除句子主语的歧义。

items.meaning: the process of removing ambiguity
items.example: Wikipedia uses disambiguation pages for words with several meanings.
items.exampleCN: 维基百科用消歧义页面处理多义词。

items.meaning: to make something ambiguous; a rare verb
items.meaningCN: 使变得含糊；使产生歧义（罕用动词）
items.example: The footnote only ambiguated the main text.
items.exampleCN: 那条脚注反而让正文更含糊了。

latinEntries.meaning: to wander about, dispute, be undecided
latinEntries.meaningCN: 四处游走；争执；犹豫不决
有双重含义的；不确定的

definition_zh: 雄心；抱负；野心；追求的目标
definition_en: a strong desire to achieve something great, or the goal that this desire aims at
core_image: 绕着目标不停奔走、四处争取支持的身影
scene: At her graduation, she said her ambition was to bring clean water to remote villages.
sceneCN: 这里 ambition 是「志向、抱负」（第 1 个义项：想做成一件大事的强烈愿望）；句意：毕业典礼上，她说自己的抱负是让偏远村庄用上干净的水。场景要点：毕业典礼、演讲、干净饮水与偏远村庄。

pos.zh: 野心；对权力或财富的强烈欲望

collocations.phrase: have no ambition to do something

derivatives.zh: 没有抱负的；不求上进的

senses.title: The drive to achieve something great
senses.definition: a strong desire to achieve something important or difficult
senses.definitionCN: 想完成重要或困难之事的强烈愿望
senses.example: Her ambition pushed her to apply for the hardest program.
senses.exampleCN: 她的抱负促使她去申请最难的项目。
senses.why: Latin ambitio began as 'a going around', especially to canvass for votes. The energy that makes a person circle a goal until it is reached is the core of ambition.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ambitio 最初是“绕着走”，尤指为拉票而四处奔走。那种让人绕着目标转到达成为止的劲头，就是 ambition 的核心。

senses.title: The goal itself
senses.definition: a particular goal that a person strongly wants to reach
senses.definitionCN: 一个人强烈想要达到的具体目标
senses.example: Her ambition was to run a school in her home town.
senses.exampleCN: 她的志向是在家乡办一所学校。
senses.why: The circling can be named by its destination. What began as the desire becomes the object desired, so an ambition can be a concrete aim.
senses.whyCN: 绕行的动作用终点来命名也说得通。起初是渴望，后来渴望的对象也被称为 ambition，于是它也可以指一个具体目标。

senses.title: Appetite for power: ambition in the negative
senses.definition: a strong, often selfish desire for power, status, or money
senses.definitionCN: 对权力、地位或金钱强烈且常显自私的欲望
senses.example: His ambition for the director's chair cost him his friends.
senses.exampleCN: 他觊觎总监之位，代价是失去了朋友。
senses.why: Early English used ambition alongside pride and vainglory. The same circling energy, when it aims only at power, becomes the negative sense.
senses.whyCN: 早期英语把 ambition 与骄傲、虚荣并列。同样的绕行动力，如果只瞄准权力，就变成了贬义的“野心”。

senses.title: Drive and initiative
senses.definition: energy and determination in pursuing work or personal goals
senses.definitionCN: 在工作或个人目标上表现出的干劲与决心
senses.example: The new coach brought ambition and discipline to the team.
senses.exampleCN: 新教练给球队带来了进取心和纪律。
senses.why: Ambition can describe the fuel rather than the destination: the force that makes someone get up and push a project forward.
senses.whyCN: ambition 也可以指燃料而不是终点：那股让人起身推动项目往前的力量。

senses.title: An institution's ambition
senses.definition: a large goal that an organization or project publicly sets for itself
senses.definitionCN: 组织或项目公开为自己设定的大目标
senses.example: The company's ambition is to cut its emissions by half in ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司的目标是十年内把排放减半。
senses.why: Modern institutions borrow the word for collective goals. The 'going around' is now done by teams, budgets and plans rather than by one candidate.
senses.whyCN: 现代机构借这个词表达集体目标。现在“四处奔走”的不是一个候选人，而是团队、预算和计划。

senses.title: Ambition for another person
senses.definition: a strong wish that someone else will succeed
senses.definitionCN: 强烈希望另一个人成功
senses.example: She had no ambition for herself but great ambition for her students.
senses.exampleCN: 她对自己没什么追求，对学生却寄予厚望。
senses.why: The desire can be transferred: the circling is done by the person who cares, while the goal belongs to someone else.
senses.whyCN: 愿望可以转移：绕行走的是关心的人，目标却属于另一个人。

senses.title: The Roman sense: canvassing for office
senses.titleCN: 古罗马义：为竞选四处拉票
senses.definition: in the original Latin sense, the practice of going around to seek votes or favour
senses.definitionCN: 拉丁语原义：为争取选票或青睐而四处走动
senses.example: Roman ambitio was the art of visiting voters before an election.
senses.exampleCN: 古罗马的 ambitio 就是选举前拜访选民的那套功夫。
senses.why: The word's oldest sense is literal: candidates walked around the city asking for support. English keeps this history inside the modern word.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最古老的意思很具体：候选人绕着城市走动、请求支持。现代英语仍把这段历史藏在词里。

senses.title: A person's scale of desire
senses.definition: the size and reach of a person's desire for achievement, as a character trait
senses.definitionCN: 作为性格特征，一个人成就欲望的大小与范围
senses.example: He is a man of ambition: he wants to change the whole industry.
senses.exampleCN: 他是个很有抱负的人：他想改变整个行业。
senses.why: When used of a person rather than a goal, ambition becomes a measure: how far that person is willing to travel for what they want.
senses.whyCN: 当它用于人而不是目标时，ambition 就成了一把尺子：这个人为了想要的东西，愿意走多远。

intro.en: Ambition is a medieval borrowing from French and Latin. Its core image, a candidate walking around to gather support, is older than its modern meaning.
intro.cn: ambition 是中世纪从法语和拉丁语借入的词。它“候选人四处奔走争取支持”的核心意象，比现代含义更古老。

items.en: First recorded as ambicioun in the mid-14th century. In early English it usually meant 'eager desire for honour or power'. It was grouped with pride and vainglory.
items.cn: 14 世纪中期以 ambicioun 形式最早记录。早期英语中通常指“对荣誉或权力的急切欲望”，常与骄傲、虚荣归为一类。

items.en: From Old French ambicion (13c.), or directly from Latin ambitionem. The French form supplied the ending that English first kept.
items.cn: 来自古法语 ambicion（13 世纪），或直接来自拉丁语 ambitionem。法语形式提供了英语最初保留的词尾。

items.en: Latin ambitio meant 'a going around', especially canvassing for votes. It was a noun of action from ambire.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ambitio 意为“绕行”，尤指为拉票而四处走。它是动词 ambire 的行动名词。

items.en: ambire 'to go around, canvass' = ambi- 'around' + ire 'to go'. The candidate circles the electorate, which is the physical picture behind the word.
items.cn: ambire“绕行、拉票”= ambi-“周围”+ ire“走”。候选人在选民周围转圈，这个词背后的画面就在这里。

items.en: The prefix goes back to PIE *ambhi- 'around, on both sides'. The second element is *ei- 'to go'. The connection between 'going around' and 'seeking office' is clear in Latin itself, not a modern guess.
items.cn: 前缀可追溯到原始印欧语 *ambhi-“周围、两边”，第二成分是 *ei-“走”。在拉丁语内部，“绕行”与“谋求职位”的联系是清楚的，不是现代人的猜测。

items.en: Modern English widened the word from political self-seeking to any strong desire for achievement. The neutral and positive use is later than the old negative one.
items.cn: 现代英语把词义从政治钻营扩展到任何强烈的成就欲。中性、褒义的用法比旧的贬义用法出现得更晚。

note.en: Look-alikes share the ambi- shape; the meaning group separates a healthy goal from a ruthless appetite for power.
note.cn: 形近组共享 ambi- 的形状；近义组区分健康的志向与不择手段的权力欲。

entries.definition: wanting very much to succeed. It is the adjective from ambition, not a separate noun
entries.definitionCN: 极想成功的。它是 ambition 的形容词形式，不是另一个名词

entries.definition: having no ambition. The -less suffix turns the noun into a negative adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 没有抱负的。-less 后缀把名词变成否定形容词。

entries.definition: surrounding, on all sides. It shares ambi- 'around' but comes from ambire in its 'surround' sense, not from ambitio.
entries.definitionCN: 周围的；环绕的。它共享 ambi-“周围”，但来自 ambire 的“环绕”义，而不是 ambitio。

entries.definition: a hope or desire to achieve something higher. It is softer and more idealistic than ambition, which stresses drive and competition.
entries.definitionCN: 希望达到更高目标的愿望。它比 ambition 更温和、更理想化，而 ambition 更强调冲劲与竞争。

entries.definition: a specific result one aims at. It names only the destination, without the emotional force of ambition.
entries.definitionCN: 瞄准的具体结果。它只命名终点，没有 ambition 那种情绪驱动力。

entries.definition: inner energy that pushes a person to act. It describes the fuel rather than the goal.
entries.definitionCN: 推动人行动的内在能量。它描述燃料，而不是目标。

entries.definition: an exaggerated claim to importance or talent. It is close to negative ambition but adds the idea of showing off.
entries.definitionCN: 夸大自己的重要性或才能。它接近贬义的野心，但多了“炫耀”的意味。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: ambi- 'around' + ire 'go', the ambire family, and the everyday adjective ambitious.
normalIntro.cn: 真实构词成分与真实同族词：ambi-“周围”+ ire“走”、ambire 词族，以及日常形容词 ambitious。

normal.en: A candidate goes around (ambire) the city to ask for votes. Ambition still carries that walking energy.
normal.cn: 候选人绕着城市（ambire）四处拉票。ambition 至今仍带着这种奔走的劲头。

normal.en: Ambitious is simply the adjective: an ambitious plan, an ambitious student.
normal.cn: ambitious 就是它的形容词：an ambitious plan（宏大的计划）、an ambitious student（有抱负的学生）。

normal.en: Unambitious uses un- to remove the drive, not to remove the goal.
normal.cn: unambitious 用 un- 去掉的是冲劲，不是目标。

normal.en: Ambition for someone else shows that the word can describe a wish, not only a personal hunger.
normal.cn: ambition for someone else 说明这个词可以描述一种祝愿，而不只是个人的渴求。

normal.en: The phrase 'achieve one's ambition' is the standard collocation: the circle finally closes.
normal.cn: achieve one's ambition 是标准搭配：绕行的圈子终于合拢。

abstract.en: Picture a person walking a circle around a distant building, never entering it yet always facing it. Ambition is that orbit: desire kept in motion.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人绕着远处的建筑走圈，始终没进去，却始终朝着它。ambition 就是这条轨道：被保持运动状态的欲望。

abstract.en: The same orbit can be political, professional, institutional or parental. The shape stays; the center changes.
abstract.cn: 同一条轨道可以是政治的、职业的、机构的，也可以是父母对子女的。形状不变，中心在换。

abstract.en: The negative sense is not a different word but a different center: when the orbit is centered on power alone, the drive becomes appetite.
abstract.cn: 贬义不是另一个词，而是另一个中心：当轨道只围着权力转，冲劲就变成了贪欲。

examples.en: Her ambition is to become the first doctor in her family.
examples.cn: 她的志向是成为家里第一个医生。

examples.en: The project was launched with the ambition of connecting every village to the internet.
examples.cn: 这个项目带着“让每个村庄都接入互联网”的宏图启动。

examples.en: He had the ambition but not the patience to learn the craft.
examples.cn: 他有雄心，却没有耐心去学这门手艺。

dict_mnemonic.text: “俺必胜”——俺一定要赢，绕着目标也要把票拉到手 → ambition 雄心、野心

root: 源自拉丁语 ambire“绕行、四处拉票”（ambi-“周围”+ ire“走”），核心是“绕着目标奔走争取”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of ambition: one orbiting energy can be named by its goal, its fuel, its institution, its object of care, or its appetite for power.
sensesIntro.cn: ambition 的八个义项：同一种“绕行”的能量，可以用目标、燃料、机构、牵挂的对象或对权力的贪欲来命名。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person walks around a goal, asking, pushing, refusing to stop.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人绕着目标奔走、争取、推动，不肯停下。

branches.en: THE FUEL: the same energy can be described as desire or as everyday drive.
branches.cn: 燃料：同一种能量既可以叫渴望，也可以叫日常的冲劲。

branches.en: THE TARGET: the goal itself, or the scale of a person's desire.
branches.cn: 靶心：目标本身，或一个人欲望的尺度。

branches.en: POWER: when the orbit centers only on status and control, ambition turns negative.
branches.cn: 权力：当轨道只围着地位与控制转，雄心就变成贬义的野心。

branches.en: THE INSTITUTION: teams and companies adopt the word for collective goals.
branches.cn: 机构：团队与公司借这个词表达集体目标。

branches.en: THE OTHER: ambition can be felt for someone else, and its Roman sense is the literal canvassing walk.
branches.cn: 他人与本源：可以为别人怀有抱负，而它的罗马义就是字面上的拉票奔走。

intro.en: Ambition is a borrowed noun. Its English family grows with -ous, -ly, -ness and the negative prefixes un- and over-.
intro.cn: ambition 是借入的名词。它的英语词族靠 -ous、-ly、-ness 以及否定前缀 un-、over- 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is ambire 'to go around'. Its family includes ambitio 'canvassing', ambitus 'a circuit', and ambitiosus 'eager for honour'.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 ambire“绕行”。其词族包括 ambitio“拉票”、ambitus“一圈、周界”、ambitiosus“急于求荣誉的”。

items.meaning: full of ambition; eager to succeed
items.meaningCN: 有雄心的；渴望成功的（-ous 表示“充满……的”）
items.example: She is an ambitious young architect.
items.exampleCN: 她是一位有抱负的年轻建筑师。

items.meaning: in an ambitious way
items.example: The city ambitiously plans to plant a million trees.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市雄心勃勃地计划种下一百万棵树。

items.meaning: the quality of being ambitious
items.meaningCN: 雄心；进取心（-ness 构成性质名词）
items.example: Her ambitiousness impressed the interviewers.
items.exampleCN: 她的进取心给面试官留下了深刻印象。

items.meaning: having little or no ambition
items.meaningCN: 没有抱负的；不求上进的
items.example: He is happy with a quiet, unambitious life.
items.exampleCN: 他满足于安静、没有野心的一生。

items.meaning: trying to achieve more than is realistic
items.meaningCN: 野心过大的；目标定得不切实际的
items.example: The schedule was overambitious from the start.
items.exampleCN: 这个时间表从一开始就定得太满。

items.meaning: without ambition
items.meaningCN: 没有抱负的（-less 表示“没有”）
items.example: The character is not lazy, just ambitionless.
items.exampleCN: 这个角色并不懒，只是没有追求。

items.meaning: more than one goal or desire
items.example: Her ambitions range from music to marine biology.
items.exampleCN: 她的志向从音乐一直到海洋生物学。

items.meaning: motivated mainly by ambition
items.meaningCN: 由雄心驱动的（复合形容词）
items.example: It is an ambition-driven industry.
items.exampleCN: 这是一个由野心驱动的行业。

latinEntries.meaning: a circuit, a boundary; also canvassing

latinEntries.meaningCN: 急于求荣誉的；谋求青睐的

definition_zh: 分析；分解；解析；精神分析
definition_en: to separate something into its parts in order to understand it
core_image: 把一整块东西沿纹路拆开，逐层看清内部
scene: In the lab, the researcher analyzed the water sample and listed every metal in the report.
sceneCN: 这里 analyze 是「化验分析、分解检测」（第 2 个义项：化学分析，确定成分）；句意：实验室里，研究员分析了水样，并在报告里列出了每一种金属。场景要点：水样、实验台、检测报告、金属成分。

senses.title: Break a whole into parts
senses.titleCN: 把整体拆成部分来研究
senses.definition: to separate a complex whole into its parts and study how they relate
senses.definitionCN: 把复杂整体拆成若干部分，并研究它们之间的关系
senses.example: The report analyzes the market into five customer groups.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告把市场拆成五个客户群来分析。
senses.why: Greek analysis meant 'a loosening, a releasing'. To analyze is to loosen a whole until its parts can be seen separately.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 analysis 意为“松开、释放”。analyze 就是把一个整体松开，直到各部分能被单独看见。

senses.title: Chemical analysis: find the ingredients
senses.definition: to determine the chemical composition of a substance
senses.definitionCN: 测定一种物质的化学成分
senses.example: The lab analyzed the soil for lead and mercury.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室分析了土壤中的铅和汞。
senses.why: A substance is a whole made of hidden parts. The oldest scientific sense of analyze is exactly this: loosen the mixture and name what comes out.
senses.whyCN: 一种物质是由看不见的成分构成的整体。analyze 最早的科学义正是如此：把混合物拆开，说出里面有什么。

senses.title: Grammar: parse a sentence
senses.titleCN: 语法分析：切分句子成分
senses.definition: to identify the grammatical parts and relations of a sentence
senses.definitionCN: 识别句子的语法成分及其关系
senses.example: Students analyzed the sentence into subject, verb, and object.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们把这个句子分析成主语、动词和宾语。
senses.why: A sentence is a whole with a structure. Parsing is the grammar version of loosening: words are sorted into their jobs.
senses.whyCN: 句子是有结构的整体。语法分析就是“松开”的语法版本：把词按各自的功能分拣出来。

senses.title: Data analysis: turn numbers into meaning
senses.titleCN: 数据分析：从数字里读出意义
senses.definition: to examine data with statistical or logical methods in order to find patterns
senses.definitionCN: 用统计或逻辑方法检查数据，以发现规律
senses.example: We analyzed three years of sales to find the seasonal pattern.
senses.exampleCN: 我们分析了三年的销售数据，找出季节性规律。
senses.why: A dataset is a heap of records. Analysis sorts the heap into variables, trends and causes, so the parts become visible.
senses.whyCN: 数据集是一堆记录。分析把这一堆分拣成变量、趋势和原因，让各组成部分显现出来。

senses.title: Psychoanalysis: listen to the mind
senses.titleCN: 精神分析：拆解心理活动
senses.definition: to treat a person by examining unconscious feelings and memories
senses.definitionCN: 通过检查潜意识的情感与记忆来治疗一个人
senses.example: The therapist analyzed the patient's dreams for hidden fears.
senses.exampleCN: 治疗师分析病人的梦，寻找隐藏的恐惧。
senses.why: The mind is treated as a whole with hidden layers. Psychoanalysis loosens those layers and looks at what has been pushed apart.
senses.whyCN: 心灵被看成一个有隐藏层次的整体。精神分析把这些层次松开，查看被压到一边的东西。

senses.title: Examine motives and causes
senses.definition: to examine the reasons behind an action or situation in detail
senses.definitionCN: 详细检查一个行为或局面背后的原因
senses.example: The historian analyzed why the reform failed so quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 历史学家分析了这场改革为何失败得这么快。
senses.why: Causes are internal parts of an event. To analyze a failure is to open it up and separate its contributing forces.
senses.whyCN: 原因是事件内部的组成部分。分析一次失败，就是把它打开，把起作用的各种力量分开。

senses.title: Analyze a text or a work of art
senses.definition: to study the structure, language, and meaning of a text or artwork
senses.definitionCN: 研究文本或作品的结构、语言与意义
senses.example: The class analyzed the opening scene of the film.
senses.exampleCN: 课堂上分析了这部电影的开场场景。
senses.why: A text is a designed whole. Analysis separates image, rhythm, argument and allusion so that the design can be explained.
senses.whyCN: 文本是被设计出来的整体。分析把意象、节奏、论证和典故分开，设计才解释得清。

senses.title: Analyze a musical structure
senses.definition: to break a piece of music into its themes, harmonies, and formal sections
senses.definitionCN: 把一首乐曲拆成主题、和声与结构段落
senses.example: The conductor analyzed the symphony before rehearsing it.
senses.exampleCN: 指挥在排练前先分析了这部交响曲。
senses.why: Music is a whole that unfolds in time. Analyzing it means separating themes and sections so the listener can hear the architecture.
senses.whyCN: 音乐是在时间中展开的整体。分析音乐就是分出主题与段落，让听者听见它的建筑结构。

intro.en: Analyze is a back-formation: the noun analysis entered English first, and the verb was formed from it. The ultimate source is Greek, not Latin.
intro.cn: analyze 是逆构词：名词 analysis 先进入英语，动词再由它造出。最终来源是希腊语，不是拉丁语。

items.en: The noun analysis is first recorded in the 1580s, meaning 'a resolving of anything complex into its elements'. It came through Medieval Latin from Greek.
items.cn: 名词 analysis 最早记录于 1580 年代，意为“把复杂事物分解为要素”。它经中世纪拉丁语来自希腊语。

items.en: The verb analyze appears around 1600. Etymonline cites Weekley's view that it was formed from the noun rather than borrowed ready-made from French analyser.
items.cn: 动词 analyze 约在 1600 年出现。Etymonline 引用 Weekley 的观点：它是由名词逆构而来，而不是直接从法语 analyser 借来。

items.en: Greek analysis meant 'a dissolving, a loosening', from ana- 'up, throughout, back' + lysis 'a loosening'. The image is a knot being untied.
items.cn: 希腊语 analysis 意为“分解、松开”，来自 ana-“向上、贯穿、返回”+ lysis“松开”。画面是一个结被解开。

items.en: lysis came from lyein 'to loosen, untie, release'. The same verb underlies dialysis and paralysis, where something is loosened apart or beside.
items.cn: lysis 来自 lyein“松开、解开、释放”。同一个动词也构成 dialysis 和 paralysis，表示“分开松开”或“旁边松开”。

items.en: The deeper root is reconstructed as PIE *leu- 'to loosen, divide'. It is a reconstructed form, not a recorded word, so the deepest layer is stated as generally accepted rather than certain.
items.cn: 更深一层被重构为原始印欧语 *leu-“松开、分开”。这是重构形式，不是有记录的词，因此最深层只能说“一般认为是”。

items.en: Modern English uses analyze across chemistry, grammar, statistics, psychology and music. The spelling analyze is standard in American English; British English prefers analyse.
items.cn: 现代英语把 analyze 用在化学、语法、统计、心理和音乐上。美式拼写是 analyze，英式更常用 analyse。

note.en: The first group is about spelling and word class; the second group separates analysis from simpler acts like looking or judging.
note.cn: 第一组看拼写与词性，第二组把“分析”和更简单的“看、判断”分开。

entries.definition: the British spelling of the same verb. The pronunciation is identical; only the ending differs.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个动词的英式拼写。读音完全相同，只是词尾不同。

entries.definition: the noun: the process or result of analyzing. It ends in -sis, while the verb ends in -ze.
entries.definitionCN: 名词：分析的过程或结果。它以 -sis 结尾，而动词以 -ze 结尾。

entries.definition: a person who analyzes data or situations. The -ist suffix marks the person, not the action.
entries.definitionCN: 分析数据或形势的人。-ist 后缀标记人，而不是动作。

entries.definition: to look at something carefully. Examining can be visual; analyzing always involves separating parts or causes.
entries.definitionCN: 仔细查看。examine 可以是视觉上的；analyze 一定涉及拆分部分或原因。

entries.definition: to cut a body or issue into parts for study. It is more physical and narrower than analyze.
entries.definitionCN: 把身体或问题切开研究。它更偏物理、范围更窄。

entries.definition: to judge the value or quality of something. Evaluation follows analysis; it adds a verdict.
entries.definitionCN: 判断某物的价值或质量。评价在分析之后发生，会给出结论。

entries.definition: to explain what something means. Interpretation goes beyond breaking down: it builds a reading.
entries.definitionCN: 解释某物意味着什么。解释不止于拆解，还要建立一套读法。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: ana- + lysis 'a loosening', plus the analysis, analyst and analytical family.
normalIntro.cn: 真实成分与同族词：ana- + lysis“松开”，以及 analysis、analyst、analytical 词族。

normal.en: lysis means 'a loosening'. Analyze is to loosen a whole until the parts separate.
normal.cn: lysis 意为“松开”。analyze 就是把整体松开，直到各部分分开。

normal.en: The noun analysis came first; the verb analyze was cut back from it, like a branch from a tree.
normal.cn: 名词 analysis 先出现；动词 analyze 是从它身上“削”出来的，像从树上截下一根枝条。

normal.en: An analyst is the person; analysis is the thing; analytical is the style.
normal.cn: analyst 是人，analysis 是事，analytical 是风格。

normal.en: Dialysis and paralysis share the same lysis ending: loosening apart, or loosening beside.
normal.cn: dialysis 和 paralysis 共享同一个 lysis 结尾：分开松开，或在旁边松开。

normal.en: In British English the verb is analyse, but the noun is still analysis in both varieties.
normal.cn: 英式英语动词写作 analyse，但名词在两种英语里都还是 analysis。

abstract.en: Think of a clock opened on a table: gears, springs and hands laid out separately. Analyze is the act of opening; analysis is the layout on the table.
abstract.cn: 想象一只钟被拆开摊在桌上：齿轮、发条、指针各自分开。analyze 是拆开的动作，analysis 是桌上的布局。

abstract.en: The same loosening works on sentences, data, dreams and symphonies. The material changes; the gesture does not.
abstract.cn: 同样的松解作用于句子、数据、梦境和交响曲。材料在变，动作不变。

abstract.en: Analysis is not destruction. The point of loosening is to see relations that were hidden while the whole stayed closed.
abstract.cn: 分析不是破坏。松开的目的是看见整体闭合时被遮住的关系。

examples.en: We need to analyze the survey results before making a decision.
examples.cn: 在做决定之前，我们需要分析调查结果。

examples.en: The teacher analyzed the sentence word by word.
examples.cn: 老师逐词分析了这个句子。

examples.en: Scientists analyzed the ice core to reconstruct the ancient climate.
examples.cn: 科学家分析冰芯，以重建古代气候。

dict_mnemonic.text: “安娜来撕”——安娜把整张纸来撕开，一层层看清里面写了什么 → analyze 分析

root: 源自希腊语 analysis“分解、松开”，由 ana-“贯穿、返回”+ lysis“松开”构成，核心是“把整体解开看清”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of analyze: the same loosening gesture applied to a substance, a sentence, a dataset, a mind, a cause, a text or a piece of music.
sensesIntro.cn: analyze 的八个义项：同一个“松开”动作，作用在物质、句子、数据集、心灵、原因、文本或音乐上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a closed whole is loosened, and its inner parts become visible.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个闭合的整体被松开，内部各部分组成可见。

branches.en: GENERAL BREAKDOWN: a complex whole or a cause is opened into contributing parts.
branches.cn: 一般拆解：复杂整体或原因被打开成若干起作用的部分。

branches.en: MATERIAL AND MUSICAL COMPOSITION: chemical ingredients and musical sections are both 'parts' of a whole.
branches.cn: 物质与音乐构成：化学成分与音乐段落都是整体的“部分”。

branches.en: STRUCTURED TEXTS: sentences and artworks have designed parts that can be separated and related.
branches.cn: 结构化文本：句子与作品都有被设计的部分，可以分开并找出关系。

branches.en: DATA: records are sorted into variables, trends and patterns.
branches.cn: 数据：记录被分拣成变量、趋势与规律。

branches.en: THE MIND: hidden layers of feeling and memory are loosened and examined.
branches.cn: 心灵：情感与记忆的隐藏层次被松开、检查。

intro.en: Analyze is a Greek-derived verb. English adds -s, -ed, -ing and then builds a large family with -sis, -ist, -ical and -able.
intro.cn: analyze 是希腊来源的动词。英语加 -s、-ed、-ing，再用 -sis、-ist、-ical、-able 建起一个很大的词族。

latinIntro.en: There is no native Latin verb family here. The word reached English through Medieval Latin analysis, but the root is Greek lyein 'to loosen', so the Latin entries are left empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有本土拉丁动词词族。这个词经中世纪拉丁语 analysis 进入英语，但词根是希腊语 lyein“松开”，因此拉丁条目留空。

items.meaning: he/she/it analyzes
items.meaningCN: 他/她/它分析（第三人称单数）
items.example: She analyzes every contract before signing.
items.exampleCN: 她签署前会分析每一份合同。

items.meaning: analyzed in the past, or used as a passive participle
items.meaningCN: 已分析；被分析（过去式或过去分词）
items.example: The samples were analyzed overnight.
items.exampleCN: 样本连夜完成了分析。

items.meaning: the act in progress
items.example: He is analyzing the latest sales figures.
items.exampleCN: 他正在分析最新的销售数据。

items.meaning: the process or result of analyzing
items.example: Her analysis of the poem was careful and original.
items.exampleCN: 她对这首诗的分析细致而有原创性。

items.meaning: a person who analyzes
items.meaningCN: 分析师；分析者（-ist 表示人）
items.example: The analyst warned that the trend could reverse.
items.exampleCN: 分析师警告说趋势可能反转。

items.meaning: relating to analysis; skilled at separating things
items.meaningCN: 分析的；善于分析的（-ical 构成形容词）
items.example: She has an analytical mind.
items.exampleCN: 她有一颗善于分析的大脑。

items.meaning: in an analytical way
items.example: We approached the problem analytically.
items.exampleCN: 我们以分析的方式处理这个问题。

items.meaning: able to be analyzed
items.meaningCN: 可分析的（-able 表示“能被……的”）
items.example: The data is analyzable with standard software.
items.exampleCN: 这些数据可以用标准软件分析。

items.meaning: not able to be analyzed
items.example: The recording was unanalyzable until the background noise was removed.
items.exampleCN: 在去掉背景噪音之前，这段录音无法分析。

items.meaning: to treat someone using psychoanalysis
items.meaningCN: 对某人进行精神分析（psycho- 表示“心灵”）
items.example: The doctor psychoanalyzed the patient over several years.
items.exampleCN: 医生对这位病人进行了数年的精神分析。

items.meaning: to analyze again, often with new methods
items.meaningCN: 重新分析（re- 表示“再次”）
items.example: The team reanalyzed the old data with a new model.
items.exampleCN: 团队用新模型重新分析了旧数据。

items.meaning: to analyze something more than is useful
items.example: Do not overanalyze a friendly remark.
items.exampleCN: 不要把一句友好的话过度解读。

definition_zh: 分析；解析；分析报告；精神分析
definition_en: the process of separating something into its parts, or the result of this process
core_image: 拆开后摊在桌面上的零件图
scene: Her analysis of three months of sales showed that weekend traffic was twice as high as weekday traffic.
sceneCN: 这里 analysis 是「分析结果、分析报告」（第 2 个义项：分析得出的结果）；句意：她对三个月销售数据所做的分析显示，周末客流是工作日的两倍。场景要点：销售数据、三个月记录、周末与工作日的对比。

senses.title: The process of breaking something down
senses.definition: the process of separating a complex whole into its parts in order to understand it
senses.definitionCN: 把复杂整体拆成部分以理解它的过程
senses.example: The analysis of the soil took three days.
senses.exampleCN: 土壤分析花了三天。
senses.why: Greek analysis was literally 'a loosening'. The noun names the act of loosening a whole until its parts can be seen.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 analysis 字面就是“松开”。这个名词命名的是把整体松开、直到各部分可见的动作。

senses.title: The result or report
senses.definition: the conclusions or written account produced by analyzing something
senses.definitionCN: 分析某事物后得出的结论或书面报告
senses.example: Her analysis showed that the new policy had not reduced costs.
senses.exampleCN: 她的分析显示，新政策并没有降低成本。
senses.why: The act leaves a product behind. Once the parts have been separated and explained, the explanation itself is called an analysis.
senses.whyCN: 动作会留下产物。部分被拆开并解释之后，这份解释本身也被称为 analysis。

senses.title: Chemical analysis
senses.definition: the identification of the chemical parts of a substance
senses.definitionCN: 确定一种物质的化学成分
senses.example: A chemical analysis revealed traces of arsenic in the water.
senses.exampleCN: 化学分析发现水中含有微量砷。
senses.why: A substance is a whole whose ingredients are hidden. Chemical analysis loosens the mixture and names each ingredient.
senses.whyCN: 物质是成分隐藏起来的整体。化学分析把混合物松开，逐一命名其中的成分。

senses.title: Mathematical analysis
senses.definition: the branch of mathematics that studies limits, functions, and continuous change
senses.definitionCN: 研究极限、函数与连续变化的数学分支
senses.example: Mathematical analysis provides the tools for describing rates of change.
senses.exampleCN: 数学分析提供了描述变化率的工具。
senses.why: Here the 'parts' are infinitesimal pieces of a changing quantity. The discipline loosens a curve into limits and small increments.
senses.whyCN: 这里的“部分”是一个变化量被切成的无穷小片段。这门学科把曲线松开成极限与微小增量。

senses.title: Linguistic or literary analysis
senses.definition: the study of the structure and meaning of a sentence, text, or work
senses.definitionCN: 研究句子、文本或作品的结构与意义
senses.example: The analysis of the poem focused on its images and rhythm.
senses.exampleCN: 对这首诗的分析集中在意象与节奏上。
senses.why: A text is a designed whole. Analysis separates its layers — grammar, image, argument, allusion — so the design can be explained.
senses.whyCN: 文本是被设计的整体。分析把语法、意象、论证、典故等层次分开，设计才解释得清。

senses.title: Psychoanalysis
senses.definition: a therapeutic method that examines unconscious feelings and memories
senses.definitionCN: 检查潜意识情感与记忆的治疗方法
senses.example: He began an analysis that lasted four years.
senses.exampleCN: 他开始了一段持续四年的精神分析。
senses.why: The mind is treated as a whole with buried layers. Psychoanalysis loosens those layers and brings what was split off into view.
senses.whyCN: 心灵被看成有掩埋层次的整体。精神分析把这些层次松开，把被分裂出去的东西带回视野。

senses.title: Statistical data analysis
senses.definition: the use of statistical methods to find patterns in a set of data
senses.definitionCN: 用统计方法在一组数据中寻找规律
senses.example: The analysis found a strong link between sleep and test scores.
senses.exampleCN: 分析发现睡眠与考试成绩之间存在很强的联系。
senses.why: A dataset is a heap of records. Statistical analysis sorts the heap into variables, correlations and trends.
senses.whyCN: 数据集是一堆记录。统计分析把这一堆分拣成变量、相关性和趋势。

senses.title: In the final analysis: the bottom line
senses.definition: in the fixed phrase in the final analysis, the conclusion reached after everything has been considered
senses.definitionCN: 用于固定短语 in the final analysis，表示把所有因素都考虑之后的最终结论
senses.example: In the final analysis, the project failed because no one owned the decision.
senses.exampleCN: 归根结底，这个项目失败是因为没有人真正对决策负责。
senses.why: The phrase is a loan translation of French en dernière analyse. It treats a whole argument as something finally resolved into its decisive part.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语直译自法语 en dernière analyse。它把一个完整的论证看成最终被分解出决定性部分的东西。

intro.en: Analysis entered English before analyze. It came from Greek through Medieval Latin and later produced the English verb by back-formation.
intro.cn: analysis 比 analyze 更早进入英语。它从希腊语经中世纪拉丁语传来，后来又通过逆构产生了英语动词。

items.en: First recorded in the 1580s as 'a resolving of anything complex into its elements'. It was used in contrast with synthesis, the putting together of parts.
items.cn: 最早记录于 1580 年代，意为“把复杂事物分解为要素”。它与 synthesis（把部分合起来）相对使用。

items.en: The immediate source was Medieval Latin analysis (15c.), which took the Greek word into learned Latin without changing its meaning.
items.cn: 直接来源是中世纪拉丁语 analysis（15 世纪），它把希腊词原样带进学术拉丁语，含义没有改变。

items.en: Greek analysis meant 'a dissolving, a loosening', built from ana- 'up, throughout, back' + lysis 'a loosening'.
items.cn: 希腊语 analysis 意为“分解、松开”，由 ana-“向上、贯穿、返回”+ lysis“松开”构成。

items.en: lysis came from lyein 'to loosen, untie'. The same verb gives dialysis and paralysis, both built on the idea of loosening apart.
items.cn: lysis 来自 lyein“松开、解开”。同一个动词给出 dialysis 和 paralysis，两者都建立在“分开松开”的想法上。

items.en: The deeper root is reconstructed as PIE *leu- 'to loosen, divide'. It is a reconstructed root, so the deepest link is stated as generally accepted rather than certain.
items.cn: 更深一层被重构为原始印欧语 *leu-“松开、分开”。这是重构词根，因此最深层联系只能说“一般认为是”，不能当作确证。

items.en: English added the back-formed verb analyze and the person noun analyst. British English spells the verb analyse but keeps the noun analysis.
items.cn: 英语又逆构出动词 analyze 和人名词 analyst。英式英语动词写作 analyse，但名词仍是 analysis。

note.en: The look-alike group is about the -sis, -ze and -ist endings; the meaning group separates analysis from neighbouring acts of study.
note.cn: 形近组关注 -sis、-ze、-ist 三种词尾；近义组把“分析”和相邻的研究动作分开。

entries.definition: the verb meaning 'to carry out an analysis'. It ends in -ze, while the noun ends in -sis.
entries.definitionCN: 表示“进行分析”的动词。动词以 -ze 结尾，名词以 -sis 结尾。

entries.definition: the plural of analysis. It is not the third-person verb analyzes, which is spelled with -zes.
entries.definitionCN: analysis 的复数。它不是第三人称动词 analyzes，后者拼作 -zes。

entries.definition: a person who performs analysis. It ends in -ist, the person suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 进行分析的人。它以 -ist 结尾，是表示人的后缀。

entries.definition: a careful look or inspection. It can be visual and need not separate parts.
entries.definitionCN: 仔细查看或检查。它可以是视觉上的，不一定拆开部分。

entries.definition: a division of information into categories or parts. It is the result of sorting, often less interpretive than an analysis.
entries.definitionCN: 把信息分成类别或部分。它是分拣的结果，解释性通常弱于 analysis。

entries.definition: a careful investigation of a subject. It is broader and can include gathering data, not only breaking it down.
entries.definitionCN: 对某一主题的仔细调查。它范围更广，可以包括收集数据，而不只是拆解。

entries.definition: an explanation of what something means. Interpretation builds a reading; analysis separates the parts first.
entries.definitionCN: 对某物含义的解释。解释要建立一套读法；分析先把部分拆开。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: ana- + lysis 'loosening', the irregular plural analyses, and the analyze/analyst family.
normalIntro.cn: 真实成分与同族词：ana- + lysis“松开”、不规则复数 analyses，以及 analyze/analyst 词族。

normal.en: The noun ends in -sis, and its plural changes to -ses: one analysis, two analyses.
normal.cn: 名词以 -sis 结尾，复数变成 -ses：one analysis，two analyses。

normal.en: The verb analyze ends in -ze; the person is an analyst; the style is analytical.
normal.cn: 动词 analyze 以 -ze 结尾；人叫 analyst；风格叫 analytical。

normal.en: Analysis and synthesis are opposites: analysis loosens, synthesis joins.
normal.cn: analysis 与 synthesis 相对：分析松开，综合拼合。

normal.en: In the final analysis is a fixed phrase rather than a literal laboratory step.
normal.cn: in the final analysis 是固定短语，不是实验室里的字面步骤。

normal.en: Dialysis and paralysis share the same lysis ending: a loosening apart or beside.
normal.cn: dialysis 和 paralysis 共享同一个 lysis 结尾：分开松开或在旁边松开。

abstract.en: Think of a watch opened on a table: the case is one thing, the gears are many. Analysis is both the opening and the layout that results.
abstract.cn: 想象一只表被打开摊在桌上：外壳是一个整体，齿轮是许多部分。analysis 既是打开的动作，也是打开后的布局。

abstract.en: The same noun covers the act, the report, and a whole mathematical discipline, because all three are organized around separated parts.
abstract.cn: 同一个名词覆盖动作、报告和一门数学学科，因为这三者都围绕“被分开的部分”组织起来。

abstract.en: Analysis is not the enemy of the whole. It is the only way to see how the whole is held together.
abstract.cn: 分析不是整体的敌人。它是看清整体如何被维系起来的唯一办法。

examples.en: The analysis of the survey data took longer than expected.
examples.cn: 对调查数据的分析比预期花了更长时间。

examples.en: Her analysis was fair: she named both the strengths and the costs.
examples.cn: 她的分析很公允：既指出了优势，也指出了代价。

examples.en: In the final analysis, the decision belongs to the voters.
examples.cn: 归根结底，决定权属于选民。

dict_mnemonic.text: “安娜来塞斯”——安娜把零件一个个塞进格子，分开摆好 → analysis 分析

root: 源自希腊语 analysis“分解、松开”，经中世纪拉丁语进入英语，核心是“把整体解开、摊开看清”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of analysis: one loosening gesture, whether it ends as a report, a chemical result, a mathematical field, a therapy, or a fixed phrase.
sensesIntro.cn: analysis 的八个义项：同一个“松开”动作，可以落成一份报告、一项化学结果、一门数学、一种治疗，或一句固定短语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whole is loosened and its parts are laid out where they can be seen.
core.cn: 核心意象：整体被松开，各部分摊开在看得见的地方。

branches.en: ACT AND PRODUCT: the loosening itself, and the report that remains after it.
branches.cn: 动作与产物：松开的过程本身，以及松开之后留下的报告。

branches.en: SCIENTIFIC AND MATHEMATICAL: ingredients of a substance and infinitesimal parts of a changing quantity.
branches.cn: 科学与数学：物质的成分，以及变化量的无穷小部分。

branches.en: STRUCTURED RECORDS: texts and datasets are sorted into layers, variables and patterns.
branches.cn: 结构化记录：文本与数据集被分拣成层次、变量和规律。

branches.en: THE MIND: buried layers are loosened in psychoanalytic treatment.
branches.cn: 心灵：在精神分析治疗中松开被掩埋的层次。

branches.en: THE BOTTOM LINE: after all parts are weighed, one decisive conclusion remains.
branches.cn: 最终结论：所有部分权衡之后，留下一个决定性的判断。

intro.en: Analysis is a Greek noun with a Latin-style plural. English builds its family with -ist, -ical, -able and the prefixes psycho-, meta-, micro- and re-.
intro.cn: analysis 是希腊名词，配拉丁式复数。英语用 -ist、-ical、-able 以及 psycho-、meta-、micro-、re- 等前缀扩展词族。

latinIntro.en: The word passed through Medieval Latin, but the root is Greek lyein 'to loosen'. There is no separate classical Latin family to list, so latinEntries is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词经过中世纪拉丁语，但词根是希腊语 lyein“松开”。没有另一支可列的古典拉丁词族，因此 latinEntries 留空。

items.meaning: more than one analysis
items.example: Two independent analyses reached the same conclusion.
items.exampleCN: 两项独立分析得出了相同的结论。

items.meaning: to perform an analysis
items.example: We analyze the results every Friday.
items.exampleCN: 我们每周五分析结果。

items.meaning: a person who analyzes
items.example: The analyst explained the chart clearly.
items.exampleCN: 分析师把图表解释得很清楚。

items.meaning: relating to analysis
items.meaningCN: 分析的（-ic 构成形容词）
items.example: Analytic thinking breaks a problem into steps.
items.exampleCN: 分析性思维把问题拆成步骤。

items.meaning: skilled at or using analysis
items.example: She wrote an analytical review of the report.
items.exampleCN: 她为这份报告写了一篇分析性评论。

items.meaning: in an analytical manner
items.example: The team approached the failure analytically.
items.exampleCN: 团队以分析的方式处理这次失败。

items.meaning: able to be analyzed
items.example: The sample is small but analyzable.
items.exampleCN: 样本虽小，但可以分析。

items.meaning: the therapeutic method founded by Freud
items.example: Psychoanalysis explores unconscious conflicts.
items.exampleCN: 精神分析探索潜意识冲突。

items.meaning: a statistical analysis that combines the results of many studies
items.meaningCN: 荟萃分析；元分析（meta-“在……之后、超越”）
items.example: A meta-analysis of twenty trials confirmed the effect.
items.exampleCN: 对二十项试验的荟萃分析证实了这一效应。

items.meaning: analysis of very small samples or details
items.example: Microanalysis identified the pigment in a single brushstroke.
items.exampleCN: 微量分析鉴定出了一笔颜料中的成分。

items.meaning: a new analysis of the same material
items.meaningCN: 重新分析（re- 表示“再次”）
items.example: The reanalysis overturned the earlier finding.
items.exampleCN: 重新分析推翻了早先的结论。

definition_en: a person from whom one is descended, or an earlier thing from which a later thing developed
core_image: 家族树最上端、把血脉往下传的那个人
scene: The first page of the family tree names an ancestor who left a fishing village and started the family line.
sceneCN: 这里 ancestor 是「祖先、祖辈」（第 1 个义项：直系血缘上的先人）；句意：族谱第一页写着一位祖先的名字，他离开渔村，开启了这一支家族。场景要点：族谱、第一页的名字、渔村、家族血脉的起点。

senses.title: A direct forebear in the family line
senses.definition: a person in your family line who lived before you, especially a direct forebear
senses.definitionCN: 在你之前生活于同一家族血脉中的人，尤指直系先人
senses.example: Her ancestor moved to the city in the 1890s.
senses.exampleCN: 她的祖先在 19 世纪 90 年代搬到了这座城市。
senses.why: Late Latin antecessor meant 'one who goes before'. An ancestor is literally the person who walked ahead of you on the family road.
senses.whyCN: 晚期拉丁语 antecessor 意为“先走的人”。ancestor 字面上就是在家族道路上走在你前面的那个人。

senses.title: Distant forebears as a group
senses.definition: the people of earlier generations taken as a group, often far back in time
senses.definitionCN: 作为整体的前代先人，通常指很久以前的人
senses.example: The festival honours the ancestors who cleared the land.
senses.exampleCN: 这个节日纪念当年开垦这片土地的祖先。
senses.why: When the individual names are lost, the same relation remains as a collective. The plural ancestors names the whole line behind a community.
senses.whyCN: 当具体名字失传，同一个关系就以集体形式保留下来。复数 ancestors 命名的是一个群体背后的整条血脉。

senses.title: A biological ancestor of a species
senses.definition: an earlier species or organism from which a later species evolved
senses.definitionCN: 较晚物种由其演化而来的早期物种或生物
senses.example: Birds share a common ancestor with dinosaurs.
senses.exampleCN: 鸟类与恐龙有共同祖先。
senses.why: Evolution is a family tree on a larger scale. The 'one who goes before' becomes an earlier form in the branching lineage of life.
senses.whyCN: 演化是更大尺度上的家族树。“先走的人”于是变成生命谱系分叉中更早的形态。

senses.title: The earlier form of a thing
senses.definition: an earlier object, design, or idea from which a later one developed
senses.definitionCN: 较晚事物由其发展而来的早期物件、设计或想法
senses.example: The modern bicycle has an ancestor with a huge front wheel.
senses.exampleCN: 现代自行车的祖先有一个巨大的前轮。
senses.why: The family metaphor is extended to objects: whatever comes before and leaves descendants is an ancestor.
senses.whyCN: 家族隐喻被扩展到物件上：任何在先出现、并留下后代的东西，都可以叫 ancestor。

senses.title: An earlier version of a text or technology
senses.titleCN: 文本或技术的早期版本
senses.definition: an earlier version of a file, program, or document from which the present one descends
senses.definitionCN: 当前文件、程序或文档由其演变而来的早期版本
senses.example: This file is an ancestor of the final report.
senses.exampleCN: 这个文件是最终报告的早期版本。
senses.why: Version history is a family tree. Earlier drafts are the ancestors of the current file, and every edit is a descent.
senses.whyCN: 版本历史就是一棵家族树。早期草稿是当前文件的祖先，每一次修改都是一次传承。

senses.title: The deceased person in inheritance law
senses.definition: in law, a person from whom another person inherits property
senses.definitionCN: 法律上，另一人从其处继承财产的人
senses.example: The estate passes from the ancestor to the heirs.
senses.exampleCN: 遗产从被继承人传给继承人。
senses.why: Property moves down the family line. The legal sense keeps the physical direction of the word: from the one who went before to the ones who follow.
senses.whyCN: 财产沿家族血脉向下传。法律义保留了这个词的物理方向：从先走的人，到后走的人。

senses.title: A cultural or intellectual predecessor
senses.definition: a person or movement that prepared the way for a later idea or art
senses.definitionCN: 为后来的思想或艺术铺路的人或运动
senses.example: The poet is an ancestor of the modern environmental movement.
senses.exampleCN: 这位诗人是现代环保运动的先驱。
senses.why: Influence also forms lineages. A thinker whose work later people build on is treated as an ancestor in the intellectual family.
senses.whyCN: 影响也会形成谱系。后来者在其成果上继续建设的思想家，就被当作思想家族里的祖先。

senses.title: An object of ancestor veneration
senses.definition: a dead relative who is honoured or worshipped in a family or community ritual
senses.definitionCN: 在家庭或社群仪式中被敬奉、祭祀的已故亲人
senses.example: The family keeps a small altar for its ancestors.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人在家里为祖先保留了一座小祭台。
senses.why: The ancestor is not only a source but a continuing presence. Ritual turns the earlier generation into someone still addressed.
senses.whyCN: 祖先不只是来源，还是一种持续的存在。仪式把前一代人变成仍然被对话的对象。

intro.en: Ancestor came from Old French, which had already reshaped a Latin word for 'predecessor'. Its English relatives ancestry and ancestral grew from the same French root.
intro.cn: ancestor 来自古法语，而古法语已经改造过一个表示“先行者”的拉丁词。英语的 ancestry、ancestral 都从同一个法语词根长出来。

items.en: First recorded around 1300 as ancestre or antecessour, meaning 'a forefather'. The modern spelling with -or settled in the early 15th century.
items.cn: 约 1300 年以 ancestre 或 antecessour 形式最早记录，意为“父辈先人”。带 -or 的现代拼写在 15 世纪早期固定下来。

items.en: From Old French ancestre / ancessor (12c.), which came from Late Latin antecessor 'one who goes before, a predecessor'.
items.cn: 来自古法语 ancestre / ancessor（12 世纪），后者源自晚期拉丁语 antecessor“先走的人、前任”。

items.en: Late Latin antecessor was a noun of agent from antecedere 'to go before': ante 'before' + cedere 'to go, yield'.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 antecessor 是 antecedere“先行”的施事名词：ante“在前”+ cedere“走、让”。

items.en: The picture is physical: someone walks ahead on the road, and later generations follow. The same verb family gives antecedent and antecede.
items.cn: 画面很具体：某个人在道路上走在前头，后代跟着走。同一个动词词族给出 antecedent、antecede。

items.en: Ante goes back to PIE *ant- 'front, forehead'. The link to 'before' is well established in Latin; the deeper PIE formation is reconstructed.
items.cn: ante 可追溯到原始印欧语 *ant-“前面、额头”。它与“在前”的联系在拉丁语中很稳固；更深的印欧构形属于重构。

items.en: Ancestry (early 14c.) came from Old French ancesserie, not from English ancestor plus a suffix. Ancestral (1520s) came from Old French ancestrel. They are siblings from the same source, not parent and child.
items.cn: ancestry（14 世纪早期）来自古法语 ancesserie，并不是英语 ancestor 加后缀造出的。ancestral（1520 年代）来自古法语 ancestrel。它们是同一来源的兄弟，不是父子关系。

note.en: The first group separates the noun from its look-alike derivatives; the second group ranks words for 'someone earlier in the line'.
note.cn: 第一组把名词与形近派生词分开；第二组按“血脉中更早的人”这一意思排列近义词。

entries.definition: the plural of ancestor: more than one forebear
entries.definitionCN: ancestor 的复数：不止一位先人

entries.definition: the whole line of ancestors, or a person's family origin. It names the line, not one person in it.
entries.definitionCN: 祖先世系；家世。它命名整条血脉，而不是其中某一个人。

entries.definition: belonging to or inherited from ancestors
entries.definitionCN: 祖先的；祖传的（形容词）

entries.definition: a person from whom one is descended. It is formal and often used of a whole line rather than one named person.
entries.definitionCN: 祖先。它偏正式，常用于整条世系，而不是某一位有名有姓的人。

entries.definition: a male ancestor, especially one honoured by a community. It carries a ceremonial tone.
entries.definitionCN: 男性祖先，尤指被社群敬奉的先人。它带有仪式感。

entries.definition: a person who held a position before you, or an earlier model of a thing. It is not limited to family lines.
entries.definitionCN: 在你之前担任某职位的人，或某物的早期型号。它不限于家族血脉。

entries.definition: a direct biological parent or the originator of a line. It is technical and stresses the source of descent.
entries.definitionCN: 直系生物学亲代，或一条世系的起源者。它偏技术，强调血缘源头。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: ante- 'before' + cedere 'go', plus the French-derived siblings ancestry, ancestral and ancestress.
normalIntro.cn: 真实成分与同族词：ante-“在前”+ cedere“走”，以及来自法语的同源兄弟 ancestry、ancestral、ancestress。

normal.en: Ante- means 'before'. An ancestor is the one who went before on the family road.
normal.cn: ante- 意为“在前”。ancestor 就是在家族道路上先走的那一位。

normal.en: Ancestry is the whole line; an ancestor is one person in it.
normal.cn: ancestry 是整条世系；ancestor 是其中一个人。

normal.en: Ancestral is the adjective: ancestral land, ancestral home.
normal.cn: ancestral 是形容词：祖传的土地、祖宅。

normal.en: Common ancestor is the standard term in biology: the branching point where two species meet.
normal.cn: common ancestor 是生物学的标准说法：两个物种在谱系上相遇的分叉点。

normal.en: In computing, an ancestor of a file is simply its earlier version.
normal.cn: 在计算机领域，文件的 ancestor 就是它的早期版本。

abstract.en: Picture a long road with walkers in single file. The people ahead are ancestors; you are at the front of the line they left behind.
abstract.cn: 想象一条长路，人们排成一列往前走。前面的人是祖先，你站在他们留下的队伍前端。

abstract.en: The word is fundamentally directional: it points backwards along a line of descent, whether that line is blood, species, objects, files or ideas.
abstract.cn: 这个词本质上有方向：它沿一条传承线向后指，不管这条线是血缘、物种、物件、文件还是思想。

abstract.en: Ancestor and ancestry are siblings, not parent and child: both came from French forms of the same Latin word.
abstract.cn: ancestor 与 ancestry 是兄弟，不是父子：两者都来自同一个拉丁词的法语形式。

examples.en: Her ancestors came to this valley more than two hundred years ago.
examples.cn: 她的祖先两百多年前来到这个山谷。

examples.en: All living things share a common ancestor if you go far enough back.
examples.cn: 如果追溯得足够远，所有生物都有一个共同祖先。

examples.en: The old typewriter is an ancestor of the modern keyboard.
examples.cn: 老式打字机是现代键盘的前身。

dict_mnemonic.text: “安塞斯特”——安塞把族谱最上面那个名字供在斯特山上，后人年年去拜 → ancestor 祖先

root: 源自拉丁语 antecessor“先行者”（ante-“在前”+ cedere“走”），经古法语进入英语，核心是“在家族血脉里走在前面的人”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of ancestor: the same backward-pointing relation is applied to family, species, objects, files, law, ideas and ritual.
sensesIntro.cn: ancestor 的八个义项：同一个“向后指”的关系，被用到家族、物种、物件、文件、法律、思想和仪式上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: someone or something walks ahead on the line, and later generations follow.
core.cn: 核心意象：某人或某物在传承线上走在前头，后代跟着走。

branches.en: FAMILY: one named forebear, or the whole collective of earlier generations.
branches.cn: 家族：一位有名有姓的先人，或前代人的整体。

branches.en: SPECIES: the branching point where an earlier organism leads to a later one.
branches.cn: 物种：早期生物通向晚期生物的谱系分叉点。

branches.en: OBJECTS AND VERSIONS: earlier designs, drafts and files stand in the same relation.
branches.cn: 物件与版本：早期设计、草稿和文件处在同一种关系中。

branches.en: LAW: property passes from the one who went before to the heirs.
branches.cn: 法律：财产从先走的人传给继承人。

branches.en: CULTURE AND RITUAL: intellectual predecessors, and the dead who are still addressed.
branches.cn: 文化与仪式：思想上的先驱，以及仍被对话的逝者。

intro.en: Ancestor is a borrowed noun. English forms its family with -s, -y, -al, -ally and -ess, plus fixed compounds such as ancestor worship.
intro.cn: ancestor 是借入的名词。英语用 -s、-y、-al、-ally、-ess 以及 ancestor worship 这类固定复合词来扩展词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is antecessor, from antecedere 'to go before'. The cedere family gives antecedent, antecede and cede, while ante 'before' also underlies anterior.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 antecessor，来自 antecedere“先行”。cedere 词族给出 antecedent、antecede、cede，而 ante“在前”还构成 anterior。

items.meaning: more than one forebear
items.example: The chapel was built by her ancestors.
items.exampleCN: 这座小教堂是她的祖先修建的。

items.structure: Old French ancesserie, same Latin source
items.meaning: the whole line of ancestors; family origin
items.meaningCN: 祖先世系；家世（与 ancestor 同源，不是英语加后缀造出）
items.example: He traced his ancestry to a small island.
items.exampleCN: 他把自己的祖先追溯到一个岛上。

items.meaning: relating to or inherited from ancestors
items.meaningCN: 祖先的；祖传的（-al 构成形容词）
items.example: They returned to the ancestral village.
items.exampleCN: 他们回到了祖籍村庄。

items.meaning: by ancestral right or descent
items.example: The title passed ancestrally to the eldest son.
items.exampleCN: 爵位按世袭传给长子。

items.meaning: a female ancestor
items.example: The ancestress of the family kept a detailed diary.
items.exampleCN: 这个家族的女祖先留下了详细的日记。

items.meaning: religious or family veneration of dead ancestors
items.example: Ancestor worship is central to many traditional festivals.
items.exampleCN: 祭祖是许多传统节日的核心。

items.meaning: the practice of honouring ancestors
items.meaningCN: 敬祖；祖先敬奉（较学术的说法）
items.example: Ancestor veneration takes different forms across Asia.
items.exampleCN: 敬祖在亚洲各地有不同形式。

items.meaning: a carved or painted image of an ancestor
items.meaningCN: 祖先像（雕刻或绘制的形象）
items.example: The museum displays wooden ancestor figures.
items.exampleCN: 博物馆展出木制祖先像。

items.meaning: a spirit of a dead ancestor in traditional belief
items.example: The ritual calls on the ancestor spirits for protection.
items.exampleCN: 仪式祈求祖灵庇护。

items.meaning: a parent node higher in a tree structure
items.meaningCN: 祖先节点（计算机树结构中位于上层的节点）
items.example: The search starts from the ancestor node.
items.exampleCN: 搜索从祖先节点开始。

latinEntries.meaning: one who goes before; a predecessor

definition_zh: 古代的；古老的；年代久远的；古人
definition_en: belonging to a period long past, or having existed for a very long time
core_image: 被风磨平了字迹的旧石碑
scene: In the museum, an ancient stone tablet is covered with a script no one uses today.
sceneCN: 这里 ancient 是「古代的、属于古代文明的」（第 1 个义项：属于古代时期）；句意：博物馆里，一块古代石碑上刻着今天没人再使用的文字。场景要点：博物馆、石碑、陌生文字、久远的年代。

forms.label: 比较级（更多用 more 构成）
最高级（更多用 most 构成）

senses.title: Belonging to an ancient civilization
senses.definition: belonging to a civilization or period of history that ended long ago
senses.definitionCN: 属于很久以前结束的文明或历史时期
senses.example: Ancient Egypt built pyramids that still stand.
senses.exampleCN: 古埃及建造的金字塔至今仍然矗立。
senses.why: The word first labelled people and things from the distant past of empires and cities. Age here is measured in civilizations, not in a few decades.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初用来标记帝国与城邦遥远过去的人和物。这里的“老”以文明计，不是几十年。

senses.title: Very old as an object
senses.definition: having existed for a very long time and showing the effects of age
senses.definitionCN: 已经存在很久，并显出岁月痕迹
senses.example: They found an ancient coin under the field.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在田里发现了一枚古币。
senses.why: Once the word was applied to objects, age alone was enough. A stone or coin could be ancient without belonging to a famous civilization.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这个词用于物件，单是年岁就够了。一块石头或一枚硬币可以很古老，却不一定属于某个著名文明。

senses.title: Very old as a person: humorous use
senses.definition: in informal or humorous use, extremely old as a person
senses.definitionCN: 在口语或幽默语境中，形容一个人非常老
senses.example: My ancient uncle still walks to the market every day.
senses.exampleCN: 我那“老古董”叔叔还每天走去市场。
senses.why: The exaggeration borrows the scale of civilizations and applies it to a single lifespan, which is where the humour comes from.
senses.whyCN: 这种夸张把“文明尺度”的年岁借来用在一个人身上，幽默感正来自这种尺度错位。

senses.title: The ancients: people of the distant past
senses.definition: the people who lived in ancient times, especially as a named group
senses.definitionCN: 生活在古代的人，尤指作为被命名的群体
senses.example: The ancients mapped the stars without telescopes.
senses.exampleCN: 古人在没有望远镜的情况下绘制了星图。
senses.why: A time word becomes a group noun. The people are named by the period they belong to, so the ancients are 'those of the ancient time'.
senses.whyCN: 一个时间词变成了群体名词。人们以所属时代被命名，所以 the ancients 就是“属于古代的那些人”。

senses.title: The academic period: ancient history
senses.titleCN: 学科分期中的“上古、古代”
senses.definition: relating to the period studied as ancient history, usually before the Middle Ages
senses.definitionCN: 属于古代史研究时段的，通常指中世纪以前
senses.example: She specializes in ancient history, not the medieval period.
senses.exampleCN: 她专攻古代史，而不是中世纪史。
senses.why: Historians need a boundary word. Ancient marks the far side of the medieval period, so the adjective becomes a technical label for a field.
senses.whyCN: 历史学者需要一个分界词。ancient 标出中世纪远端的那一段，于是这个形容词成了学科的专门标签。

senses.title: Outdated or belonging to an old order
senses.definition: old-fashioned and no longer suitable for the present
senses.definitionCN: 过时、已不适合当下的
senses.example: The company finally dropped its ancient filing system.
senses.exampleCN: 公司终于放弃了那套陈旧的档案系统。
senses.why: If something belongs to a past era, it can also be out of date. The metaphor moves from age to usefulness: old enough to be superseded.
senses.whyCN: 如果某物属于过去的时代，它也可能不再合时宜。隐喻从“年岁”滑向“有用性”：老到该被取代了。

senses.title: Geologically ancient
senses.definition: in geology, belonging to a very early period of Earth's history
senses.definitionCN: 在地质学上，属于地球历史极早的时期
senses.example: Ancient rocks in the canyon record a billion years of change.
senses.exampleCN: 峡谷里的古老岩层记录着十亿年的变化。
senses.why: The same scale extends beyond human history. Rocks can be ancient in a time frame where civilizations are only a second.
senses.whyCN: 同样的尺度延伸到人类历史之外。在文明只占一秒的时间框架里，岩石依然可以很 ancient。

senses.title: A protected ancient monument
senses.definition: in heritage law, a structure officially protected because of its age and historical value
senses.definitionCN: 在遗产法中，因年代与历史价值而受官方保护的结构
senses.example: The ruin is listed as a scheduled ancient monument.
senses.exampleCN: 这处遗址被列为法定保护古迹。
senses.why: When age becomes legal value, ancient turns into a category: old enough to belong to the nation's protected heritage.
senses.whyCN: 当年岁成为法律价值，ancient 就变成一种类别：老到足以进入国家保护的遗产名单。

intro.en: Ancient came from French, not directly from Latin. Its extra -t was added in English by analogy, and one homograph has a completely different history.
intro.cn: ancient 来自法语，而不是直接来自拉丁语。它多出来的 -t 是英语按类推加上的；另有一个同形词来源完全不同。

items.en: First recorded as auncyen in the late 14th century, used of people; by about 1400 it was also used of things. The sense 'belonging to the ancient period' is recorded around 1600.
items.cn: 14 世纪晚期以 auncyen 形式最早记录，最初用于人；约 1400 年也用于物。“属于古代时期的”这一义项约在 1600 年有记录。

items.en: From Old French ancien, which came from Vulgar Latin *anteanus 'from before'. The word did not come straight from classical Latin ante.
items.cn: 来自古法语 ancien，后者源自俗拉丁语 *anteanus“来自以前的”。这个词并不是直接从古典拉丁语 ante 借来的。

items.en: *anteanus was an adjective built on Latin ante 'before'. It is a reconstructed Vulgar Latin form, not a classical written word.
items.cn: *anteanus 是在拉丁语 ante“在前”基础上构成的形容词。它是重构的俗拉丁形式，不是古典书面词。

items.en: Latin ante 'before, in front of' goes back to PIE *ant- 'front, forehead'. The same family gives anterior and antecedent.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ante“在前、在……之前”可追溯到原始印欧语 *ant-“前面、额头”。同一词族给出 anterior 和 antecedent。

items.en: English added a -t to auncyen by analogy with words ending in -ent and -ant. The -t is not etymological, but it became the standard spelling.
items.cn: 英语受 -ent、-ant 结尾的词类推，给 auncyen 加上了 -t。这个 -t 并非词源所有，却成了标准拼写。

items.en: The noun ancient meaning 'flag-bearer, standard' (1550s) is a corrupted form of ensign. It has nothing to do with the adjective for 'old'.
items.cn: 名词 ancient 表示“旗手、军旗”（1550 年代）是 ensign 的讹变形式，与表示“古老”的形容词毫无关系。

note.en: The first group separates ancient from its own derivatives and the unrelated homograph; the second group orders words by how far back they point.
note.cn: 第一组把 ancient 与自身派生词、无关的同形词分开；第二组按“指向多远的过去”排列近义词。

entries.definition: the people of ancient times. It is a noun, while ancient is usually an adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 古人（复数名词）。ancient 通常作形容词。

entries.definition: the quality of being ancient
entries.definitionCN: 古老；年代久远（派生名词）

entries.definition: an old usage for old things or ancient customs; now rare
entries.definitionCN: 古物；古老习俗（罕用名词）

entries.definition: old and often valuable, especially of furniture or objects. It usually suggests collectible age, not a whole civilization.
entries.definitionCN: 古老且常有价值的，尤指家具或器物。它通常指可收藏的年岁，而不是整个文明。

entries.definition: very old and no longer in ordinary use, especially of words or customs. It stresses that the thing has fallen out of use.
entries.definitionCN: 非常古老且已不再日常使用，尤指词语或习俗。它强调已经退出使用。

entries.definition: belonging to the earliest ages of the world. It points further back than ancient, before human civilization.
entries.definitionCN: 属于世界最早期。它指向比 ancient 更远的过去，在人类文明之前。

entries.definition: having existed for a very long time, often of customs or problems. It is less historical than ancient and more descriptive.
entries.definitionCN: 存在了很久，常用于习俗或问题。它比 ancient 少一些历史分期色彩，多一些描述性。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: ante 'before' through French, the non-etymological -t, and the unrelated ensign homograph.
normalIntro.cn: 真实成分与同族词：经法语而来的 ante“在前”、非词源性的 -t，以及无关的 ensign 同形词。

normal.en: The -t in ancient was added by analogy; it is not part of the French source ancien.
normal.cn: ancient 里的 -t 是按类推加上的，并不在法语来源 ancien 中。

normal.en: Anterior and antecedent share the same ante- 'before' family.
normal.cn: anterior 和 antecedent 共享同一个 ante-“在前”词族。

normal.en: The ancients are not a different word: the adjective has simply become a group noun.
normal.cn: the ancients 不是另一个词：只是形容词变成了群体名词。

normal.en: Do not confuse ancient with the rare noun ancient meaning 'flag'; that one is from ensign.
normal.cn: 不要把 ancient 与罕用名词 ancient“军旗”混淆；后者来自 ensign。

normal.en: Ancient history is a field label, while 'an ancient chair' simply means a very old chair.
normal.cn: ancient history 是学科标签，而 an ancient chair 只是“一把很旧的椅子”。

abstract.en: Picture a stone whose carved letters have been worn smooth. The stone is still here, but the world that wrote on it is gone: that distance is ancient.
abstract.cn: 想象一块石碑，刻着的字已被磨平。石头还在，写字的那个世界却没了：这段距离就是 ancient。

abstract.en: The word measures depth of time, from civilizations to objects to rocks. The same adjective can look back a thousand years or a billion.
abstract.cn: 这个词量的是时间的深度，从文明到器物再到岩石。同一个形容词可以回望一千年，也可以回望十亿年。

abstract.en: When applied to a living person or a filing system, it borrows that depth for comic or critical effect.
abstract.cn: 当它用在活人或档案系统上，是借这种深度制造戏谑或批评的效果。

examples.en: Ancient Greece produced ideas that still shape our schools.
examples.cn: 古希腊产生的思想至今仍在塑造我们的学校。

examples.en: The temple was already ancient when the city was founded.
examples.cn: 这座城市建立时，那座神庙已经很古老了。

examples.en: The ancients used the stars to plan their harvests.
examples.cn: 古人利用星辰来安排收获。

dict_mnemonic.text: “俺身石”——俺身上背着一块风化的石头，走回古代去 → ancient 古老的

root: 经古法语 ancien 来自俗拉丁语 *anteanus“来自以前的”，再往上为拉丁语 ante“在前”，核心是“属于很久以前的”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of ancient: one measure of deep time, applied to civilizations, objects, people, rocks, institutions and protected ruins.
sensesIntro.cn: ancient 的八个义项：同一把“时间深度”的尺子，量文明、器物、人、岩石、制度和受保护遗址。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thing from far back in time, still present but separated from us by a long distance.
core.cn: 核心意象：来自很久以前的物件，仍在眼前，却与我们隔着很长的距离。

branches.en: CIVILIZATION AND FIELD: ancient empires, and the academic period studied as ancient history.
branches.cn: 文明与学科：古代帝国，以及作为古代史研究对象的时期。

branches.en: OBJECTS AND ROCKS: the same depth of time applied to a coin, a tablet, or a geological layer.
branches.cn: 器物与岩石：同样的时间深度用于硬币、石碑或地质层。

branches.en: PEOPLE: a joking use that applies the scale of civilizations to one lifespan.
branches.cn: 人：把文明尺度挪到一个人身上的戏谑用法。

branches.en: THE ANCIENTS: the people of the period become a collective noun.
branches.cn: 古人：那个时期的人变成集合名词。

branches.en: OUTDATED AND PROTECTED: age can mean no longer useful, or officially worth preserving.
branches.cn: 过时与受保护：年岁可以意味着不再有用，也可以意味着官方认定值得保存。

intro.en: Ancient is a borrowed adjective. Its English family is small: -ly, -ness, -ry, and the plural noun ancients.
intro.cn: ancient 是借入的形容词。它的英语词族很小：-ly、-ness、-ry，以及复数名词 ancients。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layer is ante 'before' and its family anterior, antecedent and antiquity. The French form ancien is the direct parent of English ancient.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁层是 ante“在前”及其词族 anterior、antecedent、antiquity。法语形式 ancien 才是英语 ancient 的直接来源。

items.meaning: in ancient times
items.example: The site was anciently used for ceremonies.
items.exampleCN: 这处遗址在古代曾用于仪式。

items.meaning: the quality of being ancient
items.example: The ancientness of the forest is visible in its tall trees.
items.exampleCN: 从高大的树木就能看出这片森林的古老。

items.meaning: an old word for ancient things or customs
items.example: The antiquarian collected the ancientry of the county.
items.exampleCN: 这位古物研究者收集了该县的古物。

items.meaning: the people of ancient times
items.example: The ancients built canals that still carry water.
items.exampleCN: 古人修建的水渠至今仍在输水。

items.meaning: history before the Middle Ages; also, a matter long past
items.meaningCN: 古代史；（口语）早已过去的事
items.example: That argument is ancient history now.
items.exampleCN: 那场争论现在早已是陈年旧事。

items.meaning: the civilizations of antiquity, especially the Mediterranean
items.meaningCN: 古代世界（尤指地中海古代文明）
items.example: The ancient world traded across the sea.
items.exampleCN: 古代世界跨海进行贸易。

items.meaning: a structure protected by heritage law
items.example: The stones are protected as an ancient monument.
items.exampleCN: 这些石构建筑作为古迹受到保护。

items.meaning: DNA recovered from very old remains
items.meaningCN: 古 DNA（从古老遗骸中提取的 DNA）
items.example: Ancient DNA revealed a previously unknown population.
items.exampleCN: 古 DNA 揭示了一个此前未知的人群。

latinEntries.meaning: a thing or person that goes before

definition_zh: 每年的；年度的；一年生的；年刊
definition_en: happening once a year, calculated over a year, or lasting for one year
core_image: 地球绕太阳走完一圈，又回到起点
scene: The company's annual report shows twelve months of figures, and its last page lists next year's plans.
sceneCN: 这里 annual 是「年度的、按年度编制的」（第 2 个义项：以一年为周期计算的）；句意：公司的年度报告列出十二个月的数据，最后一页是下一年的计划。场景要点：年度报告、十二个月的数据、下一年的计划。

pos.zh: 每年的；年度的；一年生的

forms.label: 比较级（更多用 more 构成）
最高级（更多用 most 构成）

senses.title: Happening once a year
senses.definition: taking place once every year
senses.definitionCN: 每年发生一次
senses.example: The village holds an annual harvest festival.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子每年举办一次丰收节。
senses.why: Latin annus means 'year'. Annual marks an event that returns when the year has completed its circle.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 annus 意为“年”。annual 标记的是一个在一年走完一圈后再次回来的事件。

senses.title: Calculated over a year
senses.definition: measured or calculated for a whole year
senses.definitionCN: 按一整年计算或统计的
senses.example: Her annual income is about forty thousand dollars.
senses.exampleCN: 她的年收入大约四万美元。
senses.why: A year is a convenient measuring cup. Any amount poured into it over twelve months can be reported as an annual figure.
senses.whyCN: 一年是一个方便的计量杯。十二个月内倒进去的任何数量，都可以报成一个年度数字。

senses.title: Lasting one year
senses.definition: valid or lasting for a period of one year
senses.definitionCN: 有效期为一年或持续一年的
senses.example: The museum sells an annual pass for frequent visitors.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆为常客出售年票。
senses.why: The circle can also be a container of time: a pass or contract that runs from one point on the circle back to the same point.
senses.whyCN: 这个圆圈也可以是一个时间容器：从圆上某一点走到回到同一点的票或合同。

senses.title: One-year life cycle: annual plants
senses.definition: in botany, completing its life cycle within one year
senses.definitionCN: 植物学中，在一个年内完成整个生命周期
senses.example: Marigolds are annual plants that die with the first frost.
senses.exampleCN: 万寿菊是一年生植物，初霜一到就枯死。
senses.why: A plant that sprout, flowers, seeds and dies inside one circle of the seasons fits the same yearly measure.
senses.whyCN: 在一轮季节循环内发芽、开花、结籽并死亡的植物，正好符合同一把“年度”尺子。

senses.title: A yearly publication
senses.definition: a book or magazine published once a year
senses.definitionCN: 每年出版一次的书籍或杂志
senses.example: The poetry annual collects the year's best short poems.
senses.exampleCN: 这本诗歌年刊收录当年最好的短诗。
senses.why: The adjective becomes a noun when the object is understood: a publication that appears on the yearly beat.
senses.whyCN: 当所修饰的对象被省略，形容词就变成名词：按年度节拍出现的一份出版物。

senses.title: A yearly event as a noun
senses.definition: an event that happens once every year, especially a regular celebration or competition
senses.definitionCN: 每年举行一次的活动，尤指固定的庆典或比赛
senses.example: The film annual attracts directors from across the region.
senses.exampleCN: 这个年度电影活动吸引了全区各地的导演。
senses.why: Like the publication sense, this noun is a shortened way of saying 'the annual event'. The calendar supplies the identity.
senses.whyCN: 和“年刊”义一样，这个名词是“年度活动”的简说。日历给了它身份。

senses.title: Yearly entitlement: annual leave
senses.definition: in employment, the paid holiday that an employee receives each year
senses.definitionCN: 雇佣关系中，员工每年获得的带薪假期
senses.example: She saved her annual leave for a long trip in spring.
senses.exampleCN: 她把年假攒到春天的一次长途旅行。
senses.why: The yearly measure also allocates rights. Leave is counted in days per year, so the entitlement is annual.
senses.whyCN: 年度尺度也用来分配权利。假期按每年多少天计算，所以这项权利是 annual 的。

senses.title: Annual ring: one year's growth
senses.definition: in a tree, the ring of wood added during one year's growth
